title: Nearby place-name and label-cache records are not destination proof
action: nearby place-name, label-cache, and object-container records mention a location-like string

sensitivityHandling.notes: Place-name values are synthetic and demonstrate a tempting false positive without exposing real route or location data.

expectedNonEvents.reason: A nearby place-name is not proof the local player selected a destination.
Label cache churn must not mutate destination state.
Object-container or place-name presence is not proof of arrival.
Loaded location-like strings are not direct player position evidence.

correlation.notes: The shared synthetic place name preserves correlation while proving that correlation alone is insufficient.

knownLimitations: This synthetic edge case guards false positives; it is not a positive destination capture.
Future positive captures must prove local-player map interaction and destination semantics separately.
verificationNotes: Unhappy-path parser tests should assert no destination, travel-arrival, or confirmed-location event is emitted.
